title: Broughton drops "Hell's Kitchen" from new project "Idle Place"
htmlContent:
Broughton shares a new single "Hell's Kitchen" from his new project called "Idle Place". The single "Hell's Kitchen" is the intro track of his project which contains 7 solid track In the album. The production sets the right tone with captivating bass, that are a match made in heaven for his flow approach, as his lyrics glide all over this track.

Broughton's "Hell's Kitchen" is an artist going for the top at it’s finest. Letting his style shine to the fullest as he takes his music to another level. The music is fresh and new, as he leaves takes the record to the moon.
